title: If I Had to Start a $1M App From Scratch, I'd Do This
description:

A lot of app founders wait until launch to find out which part of their idea people actually care about. 

Then they make one type of video, post it every day for a month, and hope one finally takes off.

The founders I’ve seen grow fastest do it differently. They’re testing their audience with content before the app is even out, and they use what they learn to decide what to build, what to put on their App Store page, and where to spend money.

I’ve talked to over 1,000 app founders, helped more than 700 with their positioning and creative strategy, and built organic growth systems inside consumer app businesses that brought in over $6M in revenue.

This is the exact blueprint I’d follow if I had to start a consumer app from zero and work it toward $1M a year.

You’ll learn:
1️⃣ How to find a category with real demand using the App Store top charts, Sensor Tower, and user reviews
2️⃣ Why the comments under viral videos tell you what to build and what messaging is missing
3️⃣ What goes in version one, and why you should start posting before the app is even out
4️⃣ Why testing 3-5 different video ideas beats posting one type of video every day and hoping
5️⃣ The founder paying around $8 per download with roughly 70% drop-off, and how to tell if a video reaches people with the problem or just curious viewers
6️⃣ When to bring on more creators, when to start spending money, and how to move a winning format from organic to paid

Topics this video covers: how to build an app, app growth strategy, how to market an app, how to grow an app on tiktok, app idea validation, ugc app marketing, consumer app growth, how to get app downloads, organic app marketing, build an app with ai, $1M app
